## Problem and resulting change

Explain what this improves for a reader, artist or researcher. Reference the issue/capability ID where relevant.

## Evidence

Describe link checks, reproduced steps, safe examples or research evidence. State unverified assumptions.

## Checked

- [ ] Current alpha behaviour is separated from proposed/research scope.
- [ ] Related guides, capability IDs and links are consistent.
- [ ] Screenshots show their actual version; examples are safe and permitted to publish.
- [ ] No private implementation, full private specification packets, credentials or confidential work is included.
- [ ] No unmeasured benchmark, adoption claim or paid infrastructure commitment is introduced.
